SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT C.COURSE_ID FROM COURSE C WHERE 1=1
AND C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY C.COURSE_ID )

SELECT C.COURSE_ID AS "courseId", C.COURSE_TITLE AS "courseTitle", C.STATUS AS "status", TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startDate", TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endDate" FROM COURSE C ORDER BY
C.COURSE_TITLE C.START_DATE C.END_DATE
CASE WHEN C.STATUS = 'Y' THEN 1 -- 진행중 WHEN C.STATUS = 'W' THEN 2 -- 예정 WHEN C.STATUS = 'N' THEN 3 -- 종료 ELSE 4 END
C.COURSE_ID
ASC DESC

SELECT C.COURSE_ID, C.COURSE_TITLE, CASE STATUS WHEN 'W' THEN '예정' WHEN 'Y' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'N' THEN '종료' END AS STATUS, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE FROM COURSE C WHERE 1=1
AND C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY C.COURSE_ID, C.COURSE_TITLE, C.STATUS, C.START_DATE, C.END_DATE ORDER BY
C.COURSE_TITLE C.START_DATE C.END_DATE C.STATUS C.COURSE_ID
ASC DESC

SELECT COURSE_TITLE, TO_CHAR(START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_DATE, CASE STATUS WHEN 'W' THEN '예정' WHEN 'Y' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'N' THEN '종료' END AS STATUS FROM COURSE WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}

SELECT E.ENROLLMENT_ID AS "enrollmentId", M.NAME AS "name", NVL(D.DEPARTMENT_NAME, '미지정') AS "deptName", NVL(P.POSITION_NAME, '미지정') AS "positionName", TO_CHAR(C.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endDate", CASE C.STATUS WHEN 'W' THEN '예정' WHEN 'Y' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'N' THEN '종료' END AS "status", NVL(CP.CHAP_COMP_RATE, 0) AS "chapCompRate"
FROM ENROLLMENT E
JOIN MEMBER M ON E.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON M.DEPARTMENT_ID = D.DEPARTMENT_ID
LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON M.POSITION_ID = P.POSITION_ID
JOIN COURSE C ON E.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID
/* 중복 제거 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENROLLMENT_ID, ROUND(AVG(CHAP_COMP_RATE), 2) AS CHAP_COMP_RATE FROM CHAPTER_PROGRESS GROUP BY ENROLLMENT_ID ) CP ON E.ENROLLMENT_ID = CP.ENROLLMENT_ID
WHERE E.COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
AND M.DEPARTMENT_ID = #{deptFilter}
AND M.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY
D.DEPARTMENT_NAME
P.POSITION_ID
M.NAME
CP.CHAP_COMP_RATE
E.ENROLLMENT_ID
ASC
DESC
SELECT DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM DEPARTMENT ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_ID ASC
